This is the place to enjoy Link Battles
with people all over the world.
If communication is interrupted during a
battle, it will be recorded as a loss for you.
Playing somewhere that has a good
connection is highly recommended.

You can freely participate in Free Battles.
To participate in Rating Battles, please
register at the Pokémon Global Link.
http://www.pokemon-gl.com

All Pokémon can participate
in Free Battles.
Your party must not contain duplicate
Pokémon or duplicate held items.

Special Pokémon cannot participate
in Rating Battles.
Your party must not contain duplicate
Pokémon or duplicate held items.
Special Battles are battles with different
regulations for each season.

To participate in Online Competitions, you need to
register at the Pokémon Global Link.
Please check the Pokémon Global Link website for info
about competitions and regulations:
http://www.pokemon-gl.com
